title: malope malacoides subsp. hispida
intro: Malope malacoides subsp. hispida, commonly known as the rough-fruited or hispid Mallow, is a subspecies of the Malope malacoides plant, which is a member of the mallow family (Malvaceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Malope malacoides subsp. hispida include soothing irritated skin, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of the plant are responsible for its therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits and applications.
